text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The season—soon to be Hangesho.
Today is finally my Make Debut.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Still got a bit of time before departure.
Looks like... Trainer isn't here yet.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Let's see, what's today's lucky color...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, all right!
Before Trainer gets here!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, how is it?! Check out this door!☆

I saw an unbelievable sight.
The entire door was dyed in a vivid orange color.
choice_data_list: This is... an apology letter, isn't it?
This is... an apology letter, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Heyyy, look closely~.
All they did was drape an orange curtain over it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: This is a brand new start for both of us! Don't you want to kick it off on a happy note? That's why—!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Time to set off☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal...
Fire, Earth, Metal, Water... and done!

Copano Rickey was warming up meticulously.
I decided to give her some words of encouragement for the main event.
choice_data_list: We're absolutely going to win today!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Really? I kind of feel like it won't be that simple, though.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: It's not that I'm being negative, but the flow of qi is unusually good, so I thought I should be extra careful instead.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "It's times like this where you gotta be careful♪ If you let it go to your head, you'll end up throwing your inner qi out of balance, okay?☆"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And next to make an entrance, the feng shui enthusiast,
Copano Rickey!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Waah, so this is what a racetrack paddock looks likeー☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Umm, umm,
which direction is which, you ask~?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see, over there is the rear demon gate.
And the entrance to the underground horse path is... hm-hm♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, pulling out a toy of all things...
You're just like a kid.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: She's all restless and fidgety, is she gonna be okay? Looks like she'd get distracted even during a race.

The onlookers watched on with heartwarming yet worried looks.
...Naturally, no one noticed. The girl's hidden side.

No matter how innocently she acts,
Copano Rickey is by no means a childish Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Alright—now I've taken full control of the room.
Today is an anniversary♪ That's right—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The day the concept of Feng Shui
is introduced to the Twinkle Series for the first time.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, now I'm fully prepared!
As long as I stay calm and ride the momentum, I know I can do it!
